messages.subject: File Encoding when importing data
parts:
I am importing a data set in Spanish and I am not able to find the correct file encoding for Distance...I tried UTF-8, Windows 1252, ISO-8859-1 and Occidental europe (ASCII/American English) from the available options in Libreoffice Calc. Labels are not correctly interpreted in either case.
I did not find anywhere any reference to the particular file encoding that Distance 8.0 assumes when importing, could someone give me a hint?
Thank you in advance.
Best regards,
Asier
